description: This file contains a PyTorch extension module that defines a custom autograd Function for creating and mutating a placeholder parameter during tracing, along with utility functions and context management to support tracing torch.nn.Parameter objects within the Dynamo JIT framework.

classes.name: TracableCreateParameter
classes.description: A custom autograd Function that creates and mutates a placeholder torch.nn.Parameter during tracing, allowing gradients to flow as if it were a real parameter.

methods.name: torch.nn.Parameter forward(ctx: Any, tensor: Any, placeholder: Any)
methods.description: Performs the forward pass, detaching the tensor if requires_grad is True, then setting the placeholder with the tensor.

methods.name: tuple[None,torch.Tensor] backward(ctx: Any, *grad_outputs: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Computes gradients during backpropagation, passing the gradient to the placeholder.

methods.name: torch.nn.Parameter tracable_create_parameter( tensor: torch.Tensor, placeholder: torch.nn.Parameter )
methods.description: Creates a parameter that can be traced, utilizing the custom autograd Function.

methods.name: torch.nn.Parameter new_parameter_placeholder( size: tuple[int, ...], dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device, requires_grad: bool )
methods.description: Creates an unbacked placeholder parameter with specified size, dtype, device, and requires_grad.

methods.name: Generator[bool,None,None] do_not_convert_to_tracable_parameter()
methods.description: A context manager that temporarily disables conversion of tensors to tracable parameters.

methods.name: bool can_convert_to_tracable_parameter()
methods.description: Checks whether tensors can currently be converted to tracable parameters.

ctags.name: backward
ctags.pattern: /^    def backward(ctx: Any, *grad_outputs: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[None, torch.Tensor]:$/

ctags.name: forward
ctags.pattern: /^    def forward(ctx: Any, tensor: Any, placeholder: Any) -> torch.nn.Parameter:$/

ctags.name: new_parameter_placeholder
ctags.signature: ( size: tuple[int, ...], dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device, requires_grad: bool )
